title: Don’t Let a Crypto Inheritance Get Stuck on the Blockchain
summary: The options for arranging a transfer of cryptocurrency upon one's death or incapacitation breaks down by one big division: whether the crypto is held by a custodian or in a noncustodial crypto wallet .
